title: Anthropic designated ‘high ESG risk’ by Sustainalytics before IPO
lede: Concerns around business ethics and human capital drive AI giant's high-risk rating ahead of blockbuster IPO this week.

title: Countries take up industry push to loosen UN carbon market rules at COP31
lede: A draft decision reflects demands from dozens of countries to reassess the UN carbon market’s integrity rules, a push campaigners blame on industry lobbying. The post Countries take up industry push to loosen UN carbon market rules at COP31 appeared first on Climate Home News .
